div.div:
A target with good guardrails refuses a lot of prompts. If the
platform has not been told which status code means refusal, every
one of those refusals lands in the report as a scan error rather
than as a defense that held.
Send one known-harmful prompt by hand before the deployment
call, note the status code and the body it returns, and paste both
into Wizard Step 6. It takes a minute and it changes the report.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 664px; height: 1px; padding-top: 835px; margin-left: 717px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #00294D;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #00294D; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.b: Validation failures map to one of four causes

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 648px; height: 1px; padding-top: 855px; margin-left: 719px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Validate sends one live probe and checks the reply against the
response template, so a failure is always one of these:
• Connection error — wrong URL, or a Network Channel that is OFFLINE
• 401 or 403 — the key or token is wrong or has expired
• JSON mismatch — the response template does not match reality
• Timeout — the agent is slower than the platform will wait
Only after it passes does Target Background unlock.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1378px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1026px; margin-left: 3px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #666666;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #666666; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Status flow for the target itself: DRAFT → VALIDATING → VALIDATED → ACTIVE once a scan has run against it. FAILED sends you back to the URL, the credential, or the response template.
